visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short, light-brown hair and a black sweater stands indoors, holding four Pokémon plushies (Squirtle, Bulbasaur, Charmander, Pikachu) toward the camera with a bright smile. (2) A man in a blue button-up shirt holds a young toddler wearing a blue bib in an indoor setting with plain walls; the toddler looks toward the side curiously. (3) The man kneels at one end of a wooden hallway, placing the four plushies in a row across the floor; he looks toward the camera expectant and smiling. (4) From a wide hallway perspective, the toddler begins crawling on all fours across the wooden floor towards the plushies while the man watches from the background in a crouched position. (5) The toddler reaches the plushies and reaches out with his right hand, eventually grabbing the orange Charmander plushie while the man in the background claps enthusiastically. (6) A close-up shot shows the toddler sitting on the floor, clutching the Charmander plushie to his chest as the man leans in to interact with him. (7) A montage of brief scenes follows, showing the toddler sitting in a high chair and playing with the Charmander plushie, smiling and inspecting the toy's tail and face.
